title: Eval Case
description: Replayable eval case under .agent/evals/<domain>/<ID>.yaml, turning an actual failure into a reusable regression case (spec §13.5, F.10). Normative example: spec §13.5 (ARCH-017). Kept permissive beyond the required fields: §13.5 layers a case as VISIBLE (unit/integration/acceptance/standards), INDEPENDENT/HIDDEN (extra scenarios, architecture checks, mutation tests, adversarial cases) and PRODUCTION (canary telemetry) — richer cases may carry more structure than the minimal example shown.

repo_snapshot.description: Pinned repo commit/snapshot the case replays against (spec §13.5, §6.1: 'Evals pin repo_snapshot for the same reason').

task.description: Task description the eval case replays (spec §13.5).

known_failure.description: The actual failure this case was captured from (spec §13.5).

required.description: Seams/behaviors that must be present for the case to pass (spec §13.5 example).

forbidden.description: Behaviors that must not be present for the case to pass (spec §13.5 example).
